reviewer.independence: Authored id/vi only; did not author or edit es/pt. No self-review of id/vi.

evidence.source: 因為這三份報價，寫的其實不是同一種金額。
evidence.authored: As 3 cotações mostram valores diferentes.

issues.problem: Valores diferentes says only that the numbers differ. The source says the quotations show different kinds/bases of amount, specifically tax-exclusive versus tax-inclusive prices.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly distinguish price/amount bases, e.g. As 3 nao cotam na mesma base de preco, with proper accents in the draft.

evidence.source: 你現在要印十張明信片，三家都寄來了報價。
evidence.authored: Imprima 10 postais; os 3 já cotaram.

issues.problem: Imprima 10 postais orders the viewer to print. The source sets up the scenario that the viewer wants to print ten and has already received all three quotes.
issues.suggested_fix: Present the need/scenario rather than an instruction to print, retaining 10 and all three supplier quotes.

evidence.source: 只寫明信片還不夠，換一種紙就可能是另一個價格。
evidence.authored: Só postais não basta: outro papel pode mudar o preço.

issues.problem: So postais nao basta can mean postcards alone are insufficient. The source specifically says that merely writing postcards as the specification is insufficient.
issues.suggested_fix: Include dizer or escrever before postais, and retain the possible price change when changing paper.

evidence.source:
三份 PDF 報價的單價不能直接放在一起排序。跟著同一組原創明信片報價，讓 AI 先整理規格、數量、含稅狀態、運費與來源頁碼，再用明示條件算出可比較的送達總價。收到修訂版、把數量從十張改成二十張後，重新核對結果。

示範使用本次 Codex AI 文件分析、pypdf 文字抽取與精確小數計算，輸出可編輯試算表；不宣稱已實測任何特定商用 AI 產品的上傳介面。供應商、價格及百分之五稅率均是原創練習設定，不是對真實交易的稅務判斷。

資料與實作日期：2026-10-26。本次 PDF 可選取文字；這條抽文流程不做掃描影像 OCR。試算表中的數值由計算工具實際計算，openpyxl 只負責寫檔，不宣稱它會計算公式。

教材包含需求、提示詞、來源 PDF 生成程式、逐頁抽文、可編輯比價表與版本紀錄。

畫面七行提示詞為觀眾任務要求；機讀欄位格式另見 analysis-prompt.txt 的 JSON 契約，本次 AI 分析也讀取了該契約。

原創教材、需求與完整提示詞：
https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/53e7243ba84b2327f7a7674acc8065f411088d96/docs/videos/ai-pdf-quotes-to-comparison/materials
evidence.authored:
Não dá para ordenar diretamente os preços unitários de 3 cotações PDF. Com este mesmo exercício original de cotações de postais, use AI para organizar especificações, quantidade, impostos incluídos ou excluídos, frete e páginas de origem. Depois calcule totais entregues comparáveis com base nas condições explícitas. Confira de novo o resultado ao receber uma revisão e mudar a quantidade de 10 para 20 postais.

A demonstração usa a análise de documentos com Codex AI realizada neste exercício, extração de texto com pypdf e cálculo decimal exato para gerar uma planilha editável. Não afirma ter testado a interface de upload de nenhum produto comercial de AI. Os fornecedores, preços e a alíquota de 5% são dados originais de prática, não uma avaliação tributária de uma transação real.

Data dos dados e da prática: 2026-10-26. Estes PDFs têm texto selecionável; este fluxo de extração não faz OCR de imagens digitalizadas. Os valores da planilha foram calculados por uma ferramenta de cálculo. openpyxl só grava o arquivo; não se afirma que calcule fórmulas.

O material inclui requisitos, prompts, o gerador dos PDFs de origem, texto extraído por página, uma tabela comparativa editável e o histórico de versões.

O prompt de 7 linhas na tela traz a tarefa para o espectador. O formato de campos legível por máquina está no contrato JSON de analysis-prompt.txt, que também foi lido nesta análise com AI.

Material original, requisitos e prompts completos:
https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/53e7243ba84b2327f7a7674acc8065f411088d96/docs/videos/ai-pdf-quotes-to-comparison/materials

evidence.source: 這次要的是送達總價，單價只是其中一個欄位。
evidence.authored: Queremos total entregue; preço unitário é um campo

evidence.source: 先把這個排序留下來，等送達總價算完，再對照名次差在哪。
evidence.authored: Guarde a ordem; após os totais entregues, compare as posições.

evidence.source: 把這幾項合起來，才是甲這份報價的送達總價。
evidence.authored: Some essas parcelas: é o total entregue de Aster.

evidence.source: 好，現在丙的送達總價算得出來了，結果剛好和甲一樣。
evidence.authored: Já dá para calcular o total entregue de Cedar: igual a Aster.

issues.problem: Total entregue / totais entregues is an unnatural calque in Brazilian Portuguese for the total cost including delivery. A total is not itself delivered.
issues.suggested_fix: Use total com entrega or an equally natural term consistently across the description and captions; preserve all other clauses.

evidence.source: 三份原檔先保留下來，輸出另外放一個資料夾。
evidence.authored: Guarde os 3 originais; salve a saída à parte

issues.problem: Salvar a saida a parte omits the explicit destination: another folder.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the separate-folder instruction, retaining the three original files.

evidence.source: 缺的就保留空值，單價和運費各自的稅，也要分清楚。
evidence.authored: Deixe nulo o que falta; separe imposto do preço e do frete.

issues.problem: Separe imposto do preco e do frete can mean separating/removing tax from the price and freight. The source asks to distinguish the tax on the unit price from the separate tax on shipping, without converting the quoted price representation.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly distinguish the goods-price tax and shipping tax; do not imply stripping tax from prices.

evidence.source: 丙的第二頁則寫運費沒有報價，這是另一種狀態。
evidence.authored: Cedar não cota frete na página 2: difere.

issues.problem: The isolated difere is abrupt and unnatural for a spoken tutorial explaining that unquoted shipping is a different state from free shipping.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a natural outro estado/outro caso or isso e diferente wording while retaining page 2 and shipping not quoted.

evidence.source: 甲的商品和運費都明示未稅，所以兩邊各算自己的稅。
evidence.authored: Aster: bens e frete sem imposto; calcule os 2.

issues.problem: Calcule os 2 grammatically points to bens e frete, not to the two respective taxes. The source requires calculating the taxes separately for both tax-exclusive amounts.
issues.suggested_fix: Name each tax separately, retaining that both goods and shipping exclude tax. Keep a budget exception rather than deleting the tax calculation instruction.

evidence.source: 乙的單價已經含商品稅，直接乘數量就能得到商品金額。
evidence.authored: Birch: com imposto, por quantidade dá o total de bens

issues.problem: Com imposto, por quantidade da o total de bens omits the unit price that is multiplied and is not natural arithmetic teaching. The included goods tax is also not explicitly tied to that unit price.
issues.suggested_fix: Name the unit price that already includes goods tax, multiply it by quantity, and identify the result as the goods amount.

evidence.source: 碰到小數時，讓計算工具依明示條件計算，再統一金額格式。
evidence.authored: Calcule decimais pelas condições; depois padronize o formato.

issues.problem: The calculation tool explicitly assigned to do the decimal calculation is absent.
issues.suggested_fix: Retain the tool calculating under the stated conditions, then standardizing the money format.

evidence.source: 不要讓模型先四捨五入單價，再把誤差一路乘上數量。
evidence.authored: Não deixe AI arredondar o preço antes e multiplicar o erro.

issues.problem: Multiplicar o erro omits multiplication by quantity, which explains how premature unit-price rounding propagates the error.
issues.suggested_fix: Preserve unit price and multiplication of its rounding error by quantity.

evidence.source: 打開試算表，把原文金額和計算金額分開核對。
evidence.authored: Abra a planilha; confira original e cálculo

issues.problem: Confira original e calculo does not clearly identify original quoted monetary amounts and calculated monetary amounts, and omits checking them separately.
issues.suggested_fix: Name both sets of amounts and their separate verification in the opened spreadsheet.

evidence.source: 還記得那個空白的運費嗎？現在它直接決定丙能不能排進名次。
evidence.authored: Lembra do frete vazio? Decide se Cedar entra no ranking.

issues.problem: Frete vazio is an unnatural description of an absent freight amount and can suggest an empty load. The earlier frete em branco states the intended blank-field meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Use frete em branco or campo de frete em branco.

evidence.source: 也要確認數量改變後費用是否相同，免得下一輪又得猜。
evidence.authored: Confirme o frete se mudar a quantidade, para não adivinhar.

issues.problem: Confirme o frete se mudar a quantidade does not explicitly ask whether the fee stays the same when quantity changes, which is the required question.
issues.suggested_fix: State the equality check directly, e.g. Confirme se o frete e igual ao mudar a quantidade, with proper accents.

evidence.source: 留下舊檔作紀錄，再用新的條件替換丙這一列。
evidence.authored: Guarde o original; renove a linha de Cedar.

issues.problem: Renove a linha is not the natural spreadsheet instruction for replacing/updating that supplier row with revised terms.
issues.suggested_fix: Use atualize/substitua a linha and retain the old file as a record.

evidence.source: 先核對這裡列的舊版編號，再把對應的舊檔標成已被取代。
evidence.authored: Confira o código anterior e marque o arquivo correspondente substituído

issues.problem: Marque o arquivo correspondente substituido lacks como and can read as marking an already-replaced file rather than marking its status as replaced.
issues.suggested_fix: Use marque ... como substituido after checking the old version code.

evidence.source: 這次改的是運費和它的稅，商品單價並沒有跟著變。
evidence.authored: Muda frete e seu imposto; o preço unitário não mudou.

issues.problem: Muda frete e seu imposto has singular verb agreement with a compound subject.
issues.suggested_fix: Use Mudam frete e seu imposto; preco unitario nao mudou, with proper accents.

evidence.source: 運費補齊後，丙比乙多了五十元，還追不上。
evidence.authored: Com frete, Cedar supera Birch em 50 TWD; não ganha.

issues.problem: Cedar supera Birch em 50 TWD can imply Cedar outperforms Birch, while the source says it costs more and still loses.
issues.suggested_fix: Use custa 50 TWD mais que Birch and retain that Cedar still is not the cheaper candidate.

evidence.source: 存檔後，在教材的程式資料夾執行這條命令。
evidence.authored: Salve; rode isto em materials.

issues.problem: The exact directory materials is correct, but em materials omits the source indication that it is a folder. The clarification fits the slot.
issues.suggested_fix: Retain the literal directory name: Salve; rode na pasta materials.

evidence.source: 這三份報價都寫明，單價在這段數量範圍內保持相同。
evidence.authored: Os 3 fixam o mesmo preço unitário dentro dessa faixa.

issues.problem: Os 3 fixam o mesmo preco unitario reads as all three suppliers having an identical unit price. In fact each keeps its own, different price unchanged over the specified range.
issues.suggested_fix: Use Os 3 mantem seus precos unitarios nessa faixa, with proper accents.

evidence.source: 送貨條件也有對應的說明，所以我們這次能照新數量重算。
evidence.authored: A entrega tem regras; dá para recalcular a quantidade.

issues.problem: Recalcular a quantidade says to recalculate quantity rather than recalculate amounts for the new quantity.
issues.suggested_fix: Say recalcular para a nova quantidade, retaining the explicit delivery terms as the reason it is allowed.

evidence.source: 甲的商品金額跟著數量增加，但運費還是那一筆。
evidence.authored: Produto de Aster sobe com a quantidade; o frete é fixo.

issues.problem: Produto de Aster sobe can mean that the product/unit price rises. The source is about the aggregate goods amount increasing with quantity while the shipping amount stays fixed.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly name the aggregate goods value, its increase with quantity, and fixed freight.

evidence.source: 乙比甲多了一百一十元，原本的先後順序反過來了。
evidence.authored: Birch supera Aster em 110 TWD; a ordem inverteu

issues.problem: Birch supera Aster em 110 TWD can suggest Birch wins by that amount. The source says Birch costs 110 TWD more and the previous price order reverses.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a direct more-expensive comparison, retaining Aster, 110 TWD, and the reversal.

evidence.source: 那最低總價是從第幾張開始換人？
evidence.authored: Com quantos muda o menor total?

evidence.source: 只多一張，最低價在哪裡換人？
evidence.authored: Quando muda o menor total?

issues.problem: Muda o menor total asks when the numeric minimum changes, rather than when the cheapest supplier changes. The latter is the quantity threshold being demonstrated.
issues.suggested_fix: Ask when o mais barato changes, retaining the quantity threshold meaning.

confirmed_checks: All 101 source/target lines were read individually against the exact source scene context.
All title, description paragraphs, tags, nine chapter names and three thumbnail fields were read.
Original worksheet fields are preserved except authored text; line sources match this exact snapshot.
Aster/Birch/Cedar mapping is consistent. Cedar revision is not counted as a fourth supplier.
Missing shipping is not silently set to zero; free Birch shipping is distinguished from unquoted Cedar shipping.
Metadata preserves fictional suppliers/prices/5% tax and does not present real tax advice.
Static workbook regeneration is retained; metadata says openpyxl writes files and does not calculate formulas.
Actual Codex document analysis and pypdf extraction remain distinct from a claimed commercial upload-interface test; no OCR claim was added.
2026-10-26 and the exact frozen materials URL are preserved; future URL changes require another check.
Money amounts 50, 110, 52.50, 7.50, 13.75 and 21.25 retain their exact TWD values; Portuguese decimal commas are localization, not currency conversion.
The literal materials folder name is correct for the source command context. Folder-noun clarity is reported above.
7dp4 keeps saving the quantity-10 file under the shown new name before changing the quantity to 20.
limitations: Only this frozen source snapshot and these exact authored-file hashes are reviewed. This is not a final-current-source or publication approval.
Character budgets are estimates. No audio synthesis, listening, actual dub-fit or timing approval was performed.
Some suggested fixes describe required meaning rather than asserting they fit the current max_chars; preserve facts and record a budget exception where needed.
No draft/source was changed by this reviewer. The original author must revise, followed by independent re-review.
